tools.name: get_checkout_link
tools.description: Get the simorago.com checkout page link for one plan, with purchasable (whether checkout is open now). Payment is made by the traveller on simorago.com in a browser; this tool does not buy anything. Use it when someone wants to buy a plan found with search_plans.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_plans" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use this when someone asks which travel eSIM to get or recommend for a trip, the cheapest data plan, or to compare plans, or how to get mobile data abroad without roaming charges. Filter by trip length (trip_days), data needed (min_gb) and budget (max_price_usd); sort by price or price per GB. Each plan has its price in USD and price per GB, data"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
